title: How Jack Kapp changed her name to Mary Lou Williams
summary: Before Jack Kapp at Decca named her Mary Lou Williams after her marriage, she had always been Burley, after her stepfather.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I just mixed them up. Often when someone was interviewing me I said Mary Lou Winn and I'd say Mary Lou Burley. One time I said Mary Louise Winn Burley, until Jack Kapp with the Decca, changed my name to Mary Lou Williams. Well, I had married John Williams, so he changed my name to Mary Lou Williams.
Up until that point had you ever called yourself professionally Mary Lou Williams?
No, never. Jack Kapp did this.
We'll get to the Andy Kirk part. You never, when you sat in with the Andy Kirk band, you were never Mary Lou Williams then?
Burley. In some of the old write-ups you'd see Mary Lou Winn Burley, or Mary Lou Winn.
But there wasn't a period in which you stopped being Mary Lou Winn and became Mary Lou Burley?
Yes, before I was named Williams, before I got married. I stuck to the Burley because I was very fond of my stepfather, Fletcher Burley.
That's when you dropped the Winn?
